$comment: FINN signal-ranking policy. Editable; validated on load (src/push/policy.ts). Tiers order the Brief: high > medium > low > routine. There is no numeric impact score: every tier comes from a named rule, shown to the user. Categories follow the ENAM reference glossary. Content rules match the filed announcement subject (and the attachment text only when FINN has downloaded it); the first matching rule for a category wins.

contentRules.pattern: intimation|notice of (the )?board meeting|to consider|will be held|is scheduled
contentRules.reason: Notice of an upcoming results meeting, not the results themselves.
Newspaper copy of results that were filed separately.
Results presentation; the results filing itself is ranked on its own.
Change involving top management (CEO, MD, CFO, chair or executive director).

contentRules.pattern: independent director|company secretary|compliance officer|nominee director|senior management personnel

contentRules.reason: Rating action that reads as negative (downgrade, negative outlook or watch).
Equity raise or buyback, which changes the share count or returns capital.
Incorporation or closure of a subsidiary: usually administrative.

combinations.reason: Unusual price move and unusual volume in the same session.
A material filing and an unusual price move within one session of each other. FINN has not established that the filing caused the move.
